During which movement was the song "Veeragandhamu Techhinaramu - Veerulevvaro Telpudi..." composed?
x:
The patriotic song "Veeragandhamu Techhinaramu – Veerulevvaro Telpudi..." was composed during the Non-Cooperation Movement (1920–22) to inspire people to participate in the national struggle against British rule. The song became popular among freedom fighters in Andhra and was sung in public meetings, processions and nationalist gatherings. It encouraged sacrifice, patriotism and courage during the early phase of the Gandhian movement. Nationalist songs played a vital role in awakening political consciousness and mobilizing people throughout the freedom struggle.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).

s: Tripuraneni Ramaswamy Chowdary's song "Veeragandhamu Techhinaramu... Veerulevvaro Telpudee" belongs to which movement?
x:
The patriotic song "Veeragandhamu Techhinaramu... Veerulevvaro Telpudee", written by Tripuraneni Ramaswamy Chowdary, became immensely popular during the Civil Disobedience Movement (1930– 34). The song inspired thousands of freedom fighters to participate in the struggle against British rule and became one of the best-known nationalist songs in Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
